name: print-social-black-orange-stacked-numerals-supply-stat-post-and-integration-tile-grid
title: Stacked Numerals Supply Stat and Integration Grid
whatItIs: A black square post with a right-aligned line 'A fixed maximum supply. Built for long-term stability.', a Discover integrations pill and a huge stack of numerals 27, 30 and 42 fading from white to grey into a solid orange 42 followed by 'billions.'; below it a teal-and-amber gradient post with a logo and a 4-by-3 grid of dark tiles holding partner icons.
whatItMeans: Fading digits climbing into an orange one turn a number into a rising graphic, and a tile grid presents partners tidily.
techniques: Numerals fading from white to orange
Small right-aligned caption above a huge figure
Outlined pill as the call to action
Dark tiles with a few coloured logo tiles
Amber and teal blurred gradient background

vocabulary.definition: Digits whose fill fades from one tone to another.
A grid of tiles showing partner logos.
Several numbers stacked to form a shape.
